drew: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 3/15 outage. We merged the postmortem but still need: owners+ETA for remediation, explicit triage commands in the runbook, and an escalation playbook update to remove ambiguity. Who can take what?
ana: I can own runbook triage edits. Ill add exact commands and a tiny decision tree.
chris-oncall: Ill own escalation playbook (who pages whom, time thresholds). I also want a short recurring check to detect the eviction ramp earlier.
ana: Example triage snippets Ill add:
```sh
# check pods with evictions
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Evicted -o wide
# eviction rate (prometheus)
curl -s "$PROM/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)"
```
chris-oncall: Canary probe I'll add to playbook (periodSeconds 30, failureThreshold 3). Also adding a 2-minute page ack rule then autodial.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6009: "Playbook edits + runbook triage commands" assigned to ana,chris-oncall. Due 2025-04-10.
drew: Action recap: ana -> runbook PR (triage + commands) by EOD Tue; chris-oncall -> escalation + canary by Fri; ops-bot -> track INF-6009. Schedule a 2-week verification drill after changes land.
